_comment: Smart Turn v3.2 per-tensor tolerances for compare_tensors.py. FINALIZED (Stage 4).
Reference: onnxruntime 1.23.2 on upstream's fp32 smart-turn-v3.2-gpu.onnx
(pipecat-ai/smart-turn-v3 @ f766f81d, sha256 ab8dc64b...), CPU, 1 thread,
session options of smart-turn inference.py; front end
transformers 4.48.2 WhisperFeatureExtractor(chunk_length=8), numpy path,
do_normalize=True. Intermediates come from the same graph with the dump
points exposed as outputs (its p is within 6e-8 of the canonical session).
Cases: all 8 in tests/golden/smart_turn/smart-turn-v3.2.manifest.json.
Recipe (porting-2-oracle), max over the 8 cases of each sidecar:
max_abs  = max(1e-4 * p99_abs, 1e-6)
mean_abs = max(1e-5 * rms,     1e-6)
FINALIZED (Stage 4): finalized = max(1.5 x observed C++ drift, provisional budget, 1e-6),
observed = max over the 8 cases of `validate.py all --family smart_turn` (default flags:
CPU backend, F32 GGUF, C++ front end, manual attention, library-default threads).
_observed records the measured C++ drift per entry.
Widened vs provisional: enc.block.2.out, enc.block.3.out, enc.final (max_abs only;
mean_abs stays within the budget) and head.pool_weights (1.5 x 3.6e-6 vs 3.6e-6).
Mechanism, checked per element: the drift sits in Whisper's massive-activation
channels (375, then 128, 17, 161) at |x| up to 160; relative to max|x| it is
<= 1.3e-4 in block 3 (<= 3.8e-4 on enc.final at one position of turn-incomplete-en,
after the LayerNorm divides by a small variance). fp32 reduction order in
attention / FFN (ggml CPU vs onnxruntime MLAS) lands there; the PyTorch twin vs
onnxruntime differs by the same amount (2.0e-2 on enc.block.3.out). The pooling
and head contract it: head.prob |dp| <= 3.2e-6 on every case.
Stage 2 predicted (confirmed above) that enc.block.2.out, enc.block.3.out and enc.final would need widening.
Two fp32 implementations of the same weights already differ by more than
the recipe there: the PyTorch twin (bridge.json, torch 2.9.0 CPU) vs the
ONNX reference, max over cases, max_abs / mean_abs:
Mechanism: Whisper's massive activations. From block 2 on, channel 375 (and
16, 128, 247 after block 3) reaches |x| 80-153 at a few positions; fp32
reduction-order differences in attention / FFN land there as up to 2e-2
absolute (about 1e-4 relative). mean_abs stays within budget and the final
LayerNorm and the softmax pooling contract it: head.pooled 5e-5, head.prob
5.4e-6 (silence, the degenerate constant-feature case; others <= 3e-6).
head.prob is the gate, with decision parity (p > threshold) against
ref/turn.json. Debug-only dumps without an entry here (MISSING is not a
failure for them): enc.pos_emb (a weight; the C++ reads it from the GGUF)
and head.pool_scores (pre-softmax pooling scores).
